svg.title: Probabilistic Data Structures: Bloom Filter, Count-Min Sketch, and HyperLogLog
svg.desc: Three-panel animated diagram matching Module 13: Panel 1 shows a Bloom Filter setting k=3 hash bits and distinguishing a definite negative from a false positive overlap; Panel 2 shows a Count-Min Sketch d x w matrix incrementing hashed cells and taking min() to bound collision overestimation; Panel 3 shows HyperLogLog splitting a 64-bit hash into register index j and leading-zero count rho to update M[j] = max(M[j], rho) before computing the harmonic mean.
svg.text: Probabilistic Structures · Bloom Filter, Count-Min Sketch & HyperLogLog
Sub-linear memory streaming summaries: membership (zero false negatives), frequency estimation (min bound), and cardinality (harmonic mean)

g.text: Bit 1 & 7 set by "cat"; bit 2 set by "eel".

Point Query Estimate: min() Across Rows
Collisions only inflate counts (>= true count).
Taking min() rejects noisy row collisions!
Update & Query: O(d) time, O(d*w) space.
Observing ρ leading zeros has prob 2^(-ρ).
Harmonic mean damps outlier spikes across m:
Mergeable across shards via element-wise max().
